mapper.select: select 'AUDIT_RECORD' as source, r.id as source_id, r.task_id as ref_id, r.action, null as operator_type, r.operator_id, r.reason_code, r.reason_text, r.create_time as event_time from audit_record r join audit_task t on t.id = r.task_id where t.biz_type = #{bizType} and t.biz_id = #{bizId} order by r.create_time, r.id limit #{limit}

select 'BUSINESS_AUDIT_EVENT' as source, e.id as source_id, e.target_id as ref_id, e.action, e.actor_type as operator_type, e.actor_member_id as operator_id, null as reason_code, e.reason as reason_text, e.create_time as event_time from business_audit_event e join audit_task t on t.id = e.target_id where e.domain_type = 'PLATFORM' and e.target_type = 'AUDIT_TASK' and t.biz_type = #{bizType} and t.biz_id = #{bizId} order by e.create_time, e.id limit #{limit}

select 'POST_ENFORCEMENT' as source, p.id as source_id, null as ref_id, concat(p.enforcement_type, ':', p.status) as action, 'SYS_USER' as operator_type, p.operator_user_id as operator_id, p.reason_code, p.rule_code as reason_text, p.create_time as event_time from community_post_enforcement p where p.post_id = #{postId} order by p.create_time, p.id limit #{limit}

select 'REPORT_TIMELINE' as source, tl.id as source_id, tl.report_id as ref_id, concat(tl.event_type, ':', tl.to_stage) as action, tl.actor_type as operator_type, null as operator_id, c.reason_code, tl.public_note as reason_text, tl.create_time as event_time from community_report_timeline tl join community_report_case c on c.id = tl.report_id where c.target_type = #{targetType} and c.target_id = #{targetId} order by tl.create_time, tl.id limit #{limit}

select 'OFFICIAL_EVENT_AUDIT_LOG' as source, l.id as source_id, null as ref_id, l.action, null as operator_type, l.operator_id, null as reason_code, l.summary as reason_text, l.create_time as event_time from official_event_audit_log l where l.event_id = #{eventId} order by l.create_time, l.id limit #{limit}
